explanation: The nonce check in verify must stay: rejecting a token whose nonce is already in seen prevents replay attacks. #123 is an issue reference for this hazard.
Call ensure_key_salt before constructing KeyManager, and abort startup if salt setup fails. KeyManager must not initialize without the salt.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, topN must be no greater than maxSimpleTopN. That bound keeps the slice at or below 1 MiB.
If meta.abi_version is missing, abi must be None; do not silently substitute the current ABI. #1784 is the related issue.
The external TLP configuration file /etc/tlp.conf is read after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so its settings override values written by this drop-in at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf.

These TLP settings require version 1.10 or newer. _AC, _BAT and _SAV name profile-specific setting suffixes. The shown call sets the battery value; leaving the AC value unset preserves GNOME’s Performance toggle.
On a JsonException, this catch block returns null so the caller can log a warning about the parse error. Throwing here would bypass that intended handling.
When an AllowedTools set is in force, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag bypasses the --allowedTools restriction.
For the verdict table relevant to thunk_is_dead, see the is_definitely_dead_code symbol in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs.
unsure: The snippet does not show whether “verdict table” is a literal table at that symbol or a description of its behavior.

explanation: Replace the hard-coded repos_skipped value with a count derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 is the tracking issue.
index.regex_query(pattern) is expected to use a linear-time DFA, so this query avoids regex backtracking and its potential performance cost.

Keep the token-family table schema in this SQL aligned with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py; changes to either schema may require changes to the other.
MAX_BATCH is 500 because the external vendor batch API accepts at most 500 items per request. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor-api documentation.

Keep these Status enum values aligned with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Their iota order determines stored integer values, so reordering Pending, Running or Done would change the meaning of existing stored values. #88 is the related issue.
The index must put tenant_id before created_at to match the orders_by_tenant query. Changing that column order would break the stated index invariant.
TList.Add must preserve FCount <= Length(FItems), meaning the item count cannot exceed the array capacity. Grow is the operation that maintains this bound.
In close, call _flush before closing _sink because closing drops _buf. Reversing the calls could discard buffered data before it is flushed.
userPath comes from a request. Resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject paths using .. that escape that root; the shown resolve and normalize expression alone does not show the required rejection.
Call ring_drain before free(buf). If buf is freed first, the interrupt handler may still access it and cause a use-after-free. #2201 is the related issue.
items.reserve(n) allocates capacity once before insertion. A profile attributed 40% of runtime to growth during push_back; doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Keep WITH (HOLDLOCK) on this SQL Server MERGE. Without it, concurrent upserts can race. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the mssql-merge documentation.
The audit operation uses an autonomous transaction so its row survives even if the caller rolls back its own transaction. Using the caller’s transaction would roll back the audit row too.

This creates a replacement table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the relevant constraints directly. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the otheralter section of the SQLite alter documentation.
The loop scans every five seconds instead of relying on inotify because the NFS mounts in question emit no inotify events. Event-only monitoring would miss changes there.
Keep the for...of loop when awaiting run(job). An await placed inside forEach would not be caught by the surrounding try/catch as intended, allowing errors to escape it.
The frame stored as Vec<u8> must have length at most MAX_FRAME. read_frame’s decoder enforces that invariant by rejecting larger frames.
Register drainHook with addShutdownHook before pool.start(), so the hook is present if SIGTERM arrives after the pool starts. The hook drains the pool during shutdown.

Move backoff’s fixed retry delay into configuration. This task is complete when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path and symbol identify the implementation to update.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among the LeaseState values Active, Released and Stale.
Pass TOKEN to tool login through standard input, never as a command-line argument. Other users can see process arguments through ps, which would expose the token.
Create the app_reader role before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists.

Make on_event idempotent because Stripe may retry a webhook for three days; processing the same event again must not duplicate its effects. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook-retries section of the Stripe documentation.
Compare the supplied and expected MACs with hmac.Equal, which performs a constant-time comparison. Using == could leak information through comparison timing.
Build CodeGraph once per index, at O(edges) cost. Do not repeat that graph construction for each query.
The packed TCustomerRec layout is part of the format of saved .dat files. Changing its fields or layout can make existing files incompatible, so bump FILE_VERSION when changing it.
Keep this MSG_MAX value synchronized with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h. A change to one requires a corresponding change to the other.
handler may rely on session.userId being non-null after authMiddleware has run. The middleware must establish that condition before this handler executes.
The cache operation uses synchronized because its check followed by put must be atomic. Merely using ConcurrentHashMap would not make that two-step sequence atomic.

raw is a user-supplied repository alias. validate_alias must check it against the registry before it is used in a path join, preventing an untrusted alias from selecting an unintended path. #1996 is the related issue.
Amounts inserted into dbo.Payments must be nonnegative. Refunds are represented as separate rows whose Kind is 'R', rather than as negative Amount values.
Set stop_ before calling worker_.join(). The stop flag tells the worker to exit; joining first could block forever.

The external GitHub API limit is 5,000 requests per hour per token, which the 720 ms limiter interval is intended to respect. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the rate-limits section of the GitHub REST documentation.
Stop the cidx service before installing the replacement binary at /usr/local/bin/cidx. Replacing a binary while it is running can fail with “Text file busy.”
Do not share the _lease credential object across jobs. Reusing it can expose one user’s credentials to another user’s job. #77 is the related issue.

The ids supplied to this DELETE must number no more than 999, the stated SQLite bound-variable limit per statement. Each id corresponds to a placeholder in marks, so exceeding the bound would make the statement invalid.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails because of a bad memory estimate, log the error and continue the job instead of aborting it.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route registered here. #530 is the tracking issue.
doc:adr-007#session-model points to the session-model section of ADR 007, which explains why SessionRegistry manages sessions per tab.
This partial index includes only leases whose released_at is NULL, matching active-lease lookups by credential_id. The comment reports that this choice makes those lookups 30 times faster.
Keep the EVENT_TYPES values aligned with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. Changes to the event list may require updates in both referenced places.
